title: DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies
abstract: arXiv:2609.32453v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. translated_title: DRAM：用于机器人操作策略的Delta规则循环联想记忆
translated_abstract: 机器人操作本质上依赖于历史信息，然而大多数预训练机器人策略仅以当前观测或短时间窗口作为条件。为这类策略配备长期记忆仍然具有挑战性：现有方法要么向骨干网络输入多帧观测窗口，这会显著增加推理成本；要么依赖预定义的语义特征，这限制了任务的通用性，并且可能还需要重新训练骨干网络以适应记忆模块。我们提出了DRAM（Delta规则循环联想记忆），这是一种即插即用的记忆模块，可以附加到各种预训练机器人策略上，无需修改网络架构或重新训练骨干网络即可赋予其长时程记忆能力，仅需对记忆模块和动作专家进行任务特定的后训练。DRAM使用门控Delta规则线性注意力来维护一个固定大小的联想记忆，并对……
tldr: 提出DRAM即插即用记忆模块，利用门控Delta规则线性注意力维护固定大小的联想记忆，可为各类预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆能力，无需修改架构或重训骨干网络。
en_tdlr: DRAM is a plug-and-play memory module based on gated delta-rule linear attention that endows a wide range of pretrained robotic policies with long-horizon memory, requiring no architectural modification or backbone retraining.
